newsitem.title: USA: Marvel aims to block bondholder bid.
newsitem.headline: Marvel aims to block bondholder bid.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc and its secured creditors intend to oppose a bondholder plan to gain control of the bankrupt company's board, Marvel said on Friday.
Marvel contends that Carl Icahn, a major holder of the company's bonds, is trying "to grab control of the company without committing a dollar."
The trading card and comic book company said it would seek the aid of the court to compel the bondholders to present a specific plan for its reorganization.
"There will be a hearing Monday afternoon and the secured creditors of Marvel will seek a stay of the court's order allowing bondholders access of the stock," a Marvel source said late Friday.

A temporary restraining order would prevent the bondholders from ousting Marvel's board on Tuesday, and would likely delay the implementation of a final reorganziation plan by sending both sides back into court.
A prior court ruling allowed bondholders to foreclose upon 80 million shares of Marvel common stock that was collateral for the bonds.
